The issuer demonstrates solid operational profitability and strong short-term liquidity, evidenced by an EBIT margin of ~17.5% ($727M EBIT on $4,165M revenue) and a current ratio of 2.19x. However, the balance sheet reflects moderate leverage (total liabilities-to-equity of 2.06x) and negative retained earnings (-$1,086M), which points to historical losses or aggressive capital distribution strategies that constrain financial flexibility. Taking into account the substantial asset base and positive net margin (~10%), the credit profile aligns with a investment-grade rating.

DECISION: BBB
